title: LoCoBench: A Benchmark for Long-Context Large Language Models in Complex Software Engineering

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating models on a balanced dataset of 10 different programming languages (10% representation each) to assess performance variations and avoid bias toward any specific programming paradigm, as well as filtering scenarios to ensure language-appropriate idioms and conventions.

Applying automated analysis to filter benchmark scenarios for potential generation artifacts, structural uniformity, unrealistic naming conventions, and content repetition that could skew evaluation results.

Using purely automated validation methods—such as compilation checks, unit/integration testing, and deterministic complexity metrics—without any LLM-as-a-judge involvement to prevent subjective evaluation bias.
